mapper.insert: insert into garden_fertilizer_state(user_id) values (#{userId}) on conflict (user_id) do nothing
insert into garden_fertilizer_claim_log(user_id, event_key, request_id, claimed_at) values (#{userId}, #{eventKey}, #{requestId}, #{claimedAt})
mapper.update: update garden_fertilizer_state set last_claimed_at = #{claimedAt}, updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into garden_fertilizer_apply_log(user_id, request_id, delta, applied_at) values (#{userId}, #{requestId}, 1, #{appliedAt}) on conflict do nothing
mapper.update: update garden_fertilizer_state s set applied_count = s.applied_count + 1, last_applied_at = #{appliedAt}, updated_at = now(), version = s.version + 1 where s.user_id = #{userId} and ((select count(*) from garden_fertilizer_claim_log c where c.user_id = s.user_id) - s.applied_count) > 0
mapper.select: select s.applied_count, s.last_claimed_at, s.last_applied_at, s.version, coalesce((select count(*) from garden_fertilizer_claim_log c where c.user_id = s.user_id), 0) as claim_count from garden_fertilizer_state s where s.user_id = #{userId}
select event_key from garden_fertilizer_claim_log where user_id = #{userId} order by claimed_at asc, id asc
